findings.text: Sequence path formatting appends a filesystem path to a sequence buffer with caller supplied escape handling and reports the emitted length or a failure marker.
Stable page flag translation converts a page snapshot into a user visible flag word and reports a hole marker when no page is supplied.
Per network namespace entry creation builds sequence based or single shot proc entries with optional write handling and caller supplied show logic and state sizing.
Per network directory creation builds a child directory under a given parent on behalf of a network context.
System control poll notification advances the event counter and wakes interruptible waiters when a poll object is present and does nothing otherwise.
Boot time memory map registration installs the maps view for systems without memory management unit support.
Boot time page info registration installs owner readable count and flag views and installs the group view only when memory control grouping is enabled.
Boot time network proc setup installs a top level alias for per process network state and registers per network namespace lifecycle handling.
Namespace directory listing and lookup resolve task bound namespace entries by name and instantiate directory entries for matches.
Count flag and group readers each delegate to a shared page scan routine with a distinct operation selector.
Network sequence and single shot open handlers acquire a network reference and bind it to private state while matching release handlers drop the reference and free private state.
Per task network lookup attribute and listing handlers resolve the owning task network context and delegate to its anchor directory.
System control header grab and finish plus entry lookup and walk helpers provide pinned iteration over registered control tables.
Namespace lookup compares candidate name length before content and reports missing on no match while holding a task reference across the whole operation.
Memory region display encodes read write execute allowances as single letters with dashes for absence and encodes sharing as shared mapped shared file or private based on may share and shared flags.

Memory region display reports zero device and inode when no file backs the region and otherwise reports superblock device and inode number with an offset derived from page offset and an appended file path only when a file is present.
Sequence path handling always finalizes the buffer even on failure and returns a negative marker when no space exists or conversion fails and otherwise returns emitted length.

Page scan validates that file offset and request length align to record stride and returns invalid on misalignment while out of range offset yields empty output and overlong requests are clamped to available range with index derived from offset division.

Page scan maps offline or hole entries to zero info and online pages to operation specific info and aborts with fault status on user copy failure while file position advances by bytes actually emitted.
Maximum dump bound uses the raw maximum frame number except under sparse memory handling where it rounds upward to section granularity to cover fully populated early sections.
Page count retrieval snapshots the page and then selects precise per page counting when mapcount tracking is enabled and average folio counting otherwise.

Stable flag output marks unmapped memory mapped anonymous and kernel samepage merging states and distinguishes compound head from tail while selecting huge transparent huge or zero page markers based on folio type and zero frame tests.

Stable flag output adds buddy idle offline pagetable and slab states plus swap cache presence and copies a fixed set of kernel page bits for locked dirty uptodate writeback lru referenced active reclaim swapbacked unevictable mlocked reserved owner private and architecture use into matching user positions with poison handling sensitive to huge versus base page and optional architecture bits.
Single bit copy extracts one kernel flag position and places its value at a chosen user flag position with all other bits clear.

Network sequence open requires private state at least as large as the network private structure and rejects write mode without a write handler and releases the network reference on allocation failure.
Iterator helpers for network sequences acquire the current network context on setup and release it on teardown when network namespace support is enabled and do nothing otherwise.

Per task network resolution takes a reference under read side protection and task locking and drops it to null when pid only mode is active and the mounter lacks network administration rights in the target user namespace.

Per task network lookup returns missing when no network context exists and listing returns invalid in the same case while attribute handling fills generic stats and overrides link count from the anchor only when the context exists.

Network namespace anchor setup uses a zeroed entry with empty child index and network back pointer and link count two and name length three under the proc root with ownership taken from user namespace root and fallback to prior values when invalid and forced lookup seeding and a mandatory statistics child whose absence frees the anchor.
Fallback directory creation helper always reports absence of an entry.

Control table pinning refuses tables already unregistering and otherwise increments use count while unpinning decrements and completes the unregister waiter when the last user drops a table marked unregistering with the caller required to hold the control spinlock.
Header grab pins the supplied header or returns a missing marker when pinning fails while finish tolerates a null header and otherwise unpins under lock.
Control entry search and iteration skip tables that are unregistering and return only pinned entries with advancement releasing the prior header before acquiring the next usable successor.
Header set resolution prefers a root specific lookup callback when present and falls back to the default set otherwise.
Region tree read semaphore is taken for reading at sequence start during positional skipping and released at sequence stop with stepping assuming the hold remains across the walk.

Control spinlock serializes use counting header grabbing table finding and red black tree stepping and is held only across the short critical section while the returned entry stays pinned after release.
Task network lookup runs under read side critical section with task locking to sample the namespace proxy and take a network reference safely.
Network reference acquired at open time is owned by sequence or single shot private state and released exactly once at release time with tracker aware put when namespace tracking is enabled.
Namespace directory file table binds generic read and seek with dedicated shared iteration and inode table binds dedicated lookup with pid aware attribute fetch and a chmod refusing setter.
No memory management unit sequence table maps start next stop and show callbacks to region tree handlers in order.
Count flag and group proc tables each mark permanent residency and bind memory style seeking with their respective read dispatcher.
Network sequence and single shot proc tables both bind network aware open plus generic sequence read and write with sequence seeking and their respective network aware release.
Per task network inode table binds network aware lookup and attribute fetch with a chmod refusing setter and file table binds generic seek and read with dedicated shared iteration.
Per network lifecycle table pairs namespace setup and teardown handlers for proc state.

Mount point table holds only a terminator and root table holds a single directory entry with empty name while the table root links a default directory header with single count and registration markers pointing back to the root and its default set.

Network entry creation configures forced lookup plus proc table pointer plus sequence logic or single shot show callback plus state sizing and optional write callback before registration under the chosen parent.
System control file system declares forward operation tables for dentries files inodes and directories without defining their contents in this fragment.

Region listing moves from start through repeated show and step to stop with start selecting the node at the requested offset by linear skipping and step advancing to the successor and incrementing position.

Page scan loops while bytes remain by translating the current frame to info copying one record to user space advancing frame and destination and reducing remaining length with cooperative rescheduling each round and final position and return reflecting total bytes emitted unless a fault occurred.

Per network proc state moves from absent to ready at namespace setup when anchor and statistics directory are linked and returns to absent at teardown when the statistics entry is removed and the anchor freed.
Control header moves between idle pinned and unregistering with pin attempts failing once unregistering starts and final unpin signaling completion to the unregister waiter.
Directory iteration starts at the earliest usable node and on each step releases the current header then selects the next usable successor leaving nothing locked but the current header pinned.
Callers must tolerate empty output when the sequence buffer has no space or path conversion or escaping fails since the routine still finalizes and reports failure.
Long page scans may return partial byte counts on user copy faults and may yield the processor each record so callers must handle short reads and retry by position.
Failure after network acquisition must release the reference to avoid leaking namespace state with distinct paths for sequence allocation failure and single shot open failure.
Iteration must revalidate usability under lock on every step because tables can enter unregistering concurrently and only the first usable successor may be returned.
Record stride equals the width of an unsigned sixty four bit quantity and the alignment mask equals stride minus one.

Well known proc names are maps for region listing and kpagecount kpageflags and kpagecgroup for page info and net stat and self net alias for network state with maps world readable and page views owner readable and root control directory readable and searchable by all.
Page scan operation selector distinguishes flag retrieval count retrieval and group retrieval.
Network anchor carries name length three and link count two with inline name storage for net and an empty child index at creation.
Network context lookup from an inode follows the parent directory data pointer and takes a reference that the caller must later release.
